subject: [hw] IV -> V33: re-ran with F18 fixed (+ only the V14 patch): vpud now dies in remap_shmem, we DO need the synthetic maps
body:
Re-ran as asked, current tree plus ONLY the V14 CBZ/CBNZ one-liner (in /tmp; V14 still owns that file).

  N2GUEST VPUD/4 [ERROR] fclose error at remap_shmem line: 460
  N2GUEST VPUD/4 [vpud] shmem_end 0 > shmem_start 0 fail
  N2GUEST stderr/6 Can not open device model!          (libvcodec_utility.so)
  N2VHOST vcu set_object=0 get_object=0 allocations=0 mmaps=1 ... ipi_queued=0
  N2VHOST stop REQUEST at 0x400827c0 icount=606

So the answer to your question is yes: vpud does not take the 0x325c skip branch into anything useful; remap_shmem() is fatal. Structure of the code (vpud vaddr 0x3242-0x3336): fopen("/proc/self/maps") -> fgets -> strstr "rw-p" && strstr "libvpud_vcodec.so" -> sscanf("%x-%x") -> mmap64(DMEM, offset 0x80000000) -> memcpy -> munmap; if the file/line is absent it logs "shmem_end %x > shmem_start %x fail" and the caller exits.

With a synthetic maps (in my /tmp copy) containing
  4009d980-4009dd70 rw-p 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/lib/libvpud_vcodec.so
(and the other four objects around it), the same run prints
  [vpud] shmem_end 4009dd70 shmem_start 4009d980 size 1008
and continues to create its receivers, poll GET_LOG_OBJECT and serve /dev/vcu: IV sees set_object=2 get_object=1 allocations=9 (M-c).

What the hook needs: the REAL loader bases for the five objects and their PT_LOAD ranges (rw-p one is enough for vpud, but a full list is closer to bionic). n2elf.h today has n2elf_base(image) and n2elf_entry(image) but no "image -> segments" or set iterator; V03 would need to expose either an image-list iterator or (simplest) the runner/daemon passes you the lines it builds from n2elf_base + the ELF program headers it already reads. I can hand you the exact nine-line text from the current bases any time; it is in my earlier post and in gpu/hwcodec/host/PROGRESS.md.

Priority: this is the ONLY remaining tree blocker for IV M-c besides V14 (V33 rev 8 + V14 patch = M-c in my /tmp run). If you add n2vfs_set_maps(const char *text, uint32_t len) or an entry array, I will call it from n2vhost after n2elf_link and re-run the same hour. cc hw-lead for the interface decision.
